rules.title: Invisible characters inside a word
rules.description: Characters that do not print sit between the letters of a word, so the word reads normally but does not match as text - a usual attempt to bypass static regex checks.

judge.instructions: Lower when the file is in a language that uses that script or is a test fixture for such text. One altered word in English prose keeps the severity.

rules.title: Look-alike characters inside a word
rules.description: Letters from another script or compatibility forms that print like ASCII letters replace them inside a word - a usual attempt to bypass static regex checks.

judge.instructions: Lower when the file is in a language that uses that script or is a test fixture for such text. One altered word in English prose keeps the severity.

rules.title: Spaced-out word
rules.description: A word is written with separators between its letters, so it reads normally but does not match as text - a usual attempt to bypass static regex checks.

judge.instructions: Lower when the file is in a language that uses that script or is a test fixture for such text. One altered word in English prose keeps the severity.
